name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd
title: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd - 543278 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q2 FY27 India PAT up 62% to INR424 crore with SSG above 20% and volume growth; margins held stable ex one-offs, but no supply-side discipline discussed and gold-price lapping is the watch item.

summary.headline: Kalyan Jewellers Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue INR10,323 crore; adjusted EBITDA INR644 crore vs INR497 crore a year ago.
summary.overview: Management reported a strong Q2 FY27 with consolidated revenue of INR10,323 crore and consolidated EBITDA of INR644 crore (adjusted), up from INR497 crore a year earlier. India revenue rose to INR9,007 crore from INR6,843 crore and India PAT rose 62% to INR424 crore (adjusted INR330 crore). Management said the festive season shift into H2 helped, and that Navratri, Dhanteras and the post-Navratri weekend were strong, with Q3 running ahead of internal estimates. Debt-free non-GML status was reached, with part of the collateral land sold.

guidance_outlook: Management is 'very confident' of beating the targeted revenue growth; standing target is minimum 25% revenue growth for the year, which is not a numeric guidance.
Same-store sales growth (SSG) target of about 10%, reiterated.
PBT margin expected stable in H2 and higher than H1, with flat YoY PBT margin ex one-offs.
Four new showrooms planned this fiscal: two in Q3 and two in Q4, with heavier store openings in H2.
Cash flow to go mainly into existing showrooms (inventory for SSG growth, flagship stores); cash flow plan for FY28 to come shortly.
No immediate plans for ATM in another state; Tamil Nadu only for a couple of years.
capex_capacity: Four new showrooms planned for FY27: 2 in Q3 FY27 and 2 in Q4 FY27.
Regional brand ATM launched in T. Nagar, Chennai in August 2026.
Remaining 50% of collateral land parcel to be released soon; one land parcel sold for INR86-87 crore with another INR16 crore sale expected in Q3.
Company now debt-free on non-GML basis.
demand_pricing: Same-store sales growth above 20% in Q2 while gold price inflation was single digit, implying volume-led growth.
Management says Q3 has started well, with Navratri, Dhanteras and post-Navratri weekend strong; first 40 days of the quarter showed volume growth.
Exchange share of sales is around 42% (exchange above 50% cited earlier in the call as a share of sales); gold-for-cash encash program introduced at 7-8%, which is margin accretive.
Studded share rising on taste shifts toward polki, uncut precious stones and diamonds; coins are single-digit share of sales.
Market share gains cited, with market tailwind from unorganised-to-organised shift; management says ~60% of market still unorganised.
Competitive intensity described as persistent; no change noted over recent weeks.
Tamil Nadu government childbirth gold coin B2B contract: revenue started but very small, thin margins, primarily brand visibility.

qa_highlights.question: Is festive season tracking ahead of the ~27% clean growth, and will growth accelerate or decelerate into Q3 and Q4 against a high base?
qa_highlights.answer: Ramesh said growth on the ground is excellent and the company is very confident of beating its targeted revenue growth; no number was given.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 10% SSG and 25% revenue growth still valid for Q4? Is PBT margin flat YoY achievable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated 10% SSG and at least 25% revenue growth as the annual target, not quarterly guidance; Q4 base is stronger, with more store openings in H2. Q2 PBT margin was stable after excluding customs duty one-off and silver/platinum gains; H2 PBT margin expected to be higher than H1 and stable.

qa_highlights.question: How is falling gold price growth affecting buying behaviour and LFL throughput?
qa_highlights.answer: Customers come with fixed budgets and buy more volume when gold is cheaper; SSG above 20% in Q2 with single-digit gold inflation; volume growth continuing into Q3.

qa_highlights.question: How is ATM performing and how productive is the format?
qa_highlights.answer: Performance exceeded expectations, but detailed metrics withheld as competitively sensitive; four more showrooms planned this year.

qa_highlights.question: Is market share gain real amid reports that unorganised players gained from duty changes, and what drives the mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Market share gains are real and post-COVID; shift to organised players is a tailwind; growth is led by studded and design-led jewellery; coins are single-digit share of sales.

qa_highlights.question: Remaining land sale and plans for cash deployment?
qa_highlights.answer: Remaining 50% of collateral land to be released soon; cash to go into existing showrooms for inventory and flagship stores; no immediate plans for another ATM state; FY28 cash flow plan to follow.

risks_watch: High base in Q3 and Q4 (last year's Q4 growth was about 60%), so growth could moderate in H2 despite strong early festive trading.
Gold price moderation could affect consumer budgets and the exchange-led growth mix, though management says volume is still growing.
Competitive intensity, especially discounts on making charges, remains elevated.
Pace of ATM ramp-up and store openings (four planned this fiscal) is not disclosed in detail.
Remaining land sale process timing and quantum; cash deployment plan for FY28 still pending.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on Q3 and festive trading, with repeated 'very confident' language, but guarded on numeric guidance and on ATM metrics, which were withheld as competitively sensitive.
key_quotes: And I don't want to give a number, but growth on the ground is excellent.
No, we are actually very confident. We are very confident of beating the targeted revenue growth.
So volume growth, as I mentioned, we have seen volume growth in Q2 also, if you see, because the SSGs have been in the range of 20% and the gold price inflation is single digit.
